Senior Backend Engineer
Location: Remote

About us
We are a fast-growing startup; our mobile team uses Swift and Kotlin.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs and microservices
- Own deployments on AWS

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- 3+ years of Python
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to have
- Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Terraform
- Experience with GraphQL is a plus

Benefits
- Free Redis stickers and a learning budget
